analysis.J: repetition means within phase -> 4 equal phase blocks -> per-surface mean; J = minimum over B_curv / M10_curv / M24_curv
analysis.cross_family: condition-matched means only, no image pairing
analysis.gates: per image: point RMSE <= 0.30 mm, w = 0, u / (c + w + u) <= 5 %, defined metrics and exposure; no output = C_tau 0 and stays in the denominator
analysis.intervals: phase-block range (min / max of the four block means); no resampling of points or sigma levels

policy.aggregate: repetitions within phase -> four equal phases -> worst surface
policy.tie: reference if near best; else smaller maximum image point RMSE, then config ID

analysis.selection: mp06d analysis.tables (frozen), applied to the 22440 new images alone

1_T8x4_low_noise.statement: T8x4 has a higher main-requirement J than R8x4 and R8x6 at low noise (sigma 0 / 20) across the 10 environments

2_dot_sigma40_60.statement: sigma 40-60: admissible set, near-optimal set and representative among small dots, sparse spacing and the staggered lattice

3_lines_blur_lighting.statement: lines: wider lines are selected as blur increases; line width / pitch choice under illumination loss

4_tau_family_switch.statement: relaxing tau from 0.15 to 0.30 mm moves the family choice from dots to lines at low noise

5_peak_cap_interactions.statement: small-dot sparsification gain limited by the peak cap; size-spacing interaction differs for small and large dots; line interaction changes sign with environment

6_sigma80_100_fail.statement: main requirement: no admissible candidate at sigma 80 and 100

7_near_floor.statement: conditions within 2 pp of the 50 % / 70 % floor (admissible representative just above, or a gate-safe candidate just below)

figure_rules.note: fixed before any new image; no-output panels are shown as they are; no replacement by successful cases; at most one additional diagnostic board, chosen mechanically by the largest gate deviation, if a new failure needs to be shown

labels.boundary_changed: Admissibility boundary changed: no admissible candidate originally, admissible candidate(s) in the new phases
labels.fail_repeated: Failure region reproduced: no admissible candidate originally or in the new phases
labels.kept: Original recommendation and near-optimal range reproduced: original representative admissible and within 2 pp of the best admissible same-family candidate
labels.not_confirmed: Recommendation not confirmed: original representative not admissible; failing gate and margin listed
labels.usable_reorder: Usability reproduced, ranking changed: original representative admissible but more than 2 pp behind

line.rule: geometry maximin over the 20000-point sqrt(2)-1 sequence (periodic phase-fraction distance, all pitches)

point.metric: min(R-torus, T-torus) distance in cell units
point.rule: legacy rule: first golden-sequence points (k ascending) at >= 0.05 cell from every used phase and from the accepted blocks

seed_rule: seed = base[family] + 100 * surface index + 10 * block + rep; sigma 0 without noise draw
